title: Azad Engineering Ltd. (NSE: AZAD) — Company Dossier
primer: REJECTED on valuation and asymmetry, not on a broken business. AZAD is a qualified, fast-growing supplier with a large order book, but its operating cash flow has been negative while reported profit rose. The base-case value of ₹2,373 is 3.9% below the ₹2,468.40 close on 12 November 2026, and the support-zone asymmetry is 1.44:1 against a 1.5:1 minimum. The asymmetry gate alone would clear near 90x at the zone top, and negative operating cash flow is a separate reason for REJECTED. Nothing is bought, the stock is not held, and cash takes the next marginal rupee; several figures rest on aggregators rather than primary filings, as the gate exceptions list.
holding_rationale: AZAD does not appear in the 12 November Zerodha positions ledger, and the last transaction on that account was dated 11 November. There is nothing to sell. The instruction for a new investor is not to initiate, because the verdict is REJECTED and the support-zone asymmetry is below the minimum.

horizons.rationale: Stage 3 by the market-facts trend filter and CAP_WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT by the timing gate. Price is 3.8% below the 20-day average and 9.3% below the falling 50-day average, and relative strength over 28 sessions is −28.5%.
Order book of about ₹6,500 crore and 25%+ guidance are strong, but H1 FY2027 profit grew 6.6% against 28.6% revenue growth, and operating cash flow was negative in FY2026 and H1 FY2027.
Qualification depth and long customer relationships are real assets. Returns on the new capacity, cash conversion and repeat programme wins across a full cycle are not yet demonstrated.

gate_exceptions: Blind-pass disclosure: the orchestrating agent read the AZAD watchlist entry, including its verdict blurb and reference price, before the isolated Pass 1 subagent ran. The Pass 1 subagent itself did not receive the watchlist, shortlist or holdings files. The blind-pass check passed on ch-1 to ch-6 with 9,002 web words and no verdict or timing tokens.

Source quality: most financial claims rest on aggregators and press reports, including stockanalysis, Financial Express, marketping, Quartr summaries, a Substack, Yahoo Finance and ICICI Direct news, with Wikipedia used for the peer parallels. Primary NSE and BSE filings and the company's own annual report were not retrieved for the figures used here. The research contract restricts aggregators as the sole source for financial claims, and citation_check.py does not enforce that rule in code. This is disclosed rather than cured.

They are historical analogies, not current data.

Revenue basis conflict: FY2026 revenue appears as ₹603 crore consolidated in the ledger and Screener, ₹590 crore on the call basis, and ₹6,029.75 million in the annual-report extract. Debtor days for FY2025 appear as 178 in one source and 158 in another. The dossier uses ₹603 crore and 158 days and discloses both.

Options snapshot conflict: the embedded business-quality label reads COMPOUNDER_PASS, which contradicts the Pass 1 verdict of CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL. The dossier uses the Pass 1 verdict and states the conflict in ch-8.

Market-wide scan: the stage2_scanner.py run failed twice with AppleScript Chrome tab-index errors before completing on the third attempt. The AZAD company snapshot was captured in the same run. The 13 November TradingView readings are intraday and incomplete and are labelled separately from the 12 November market-facts ledger.

Research gaps: segment profit by vertical, per-part margin or win rate, and top-customer share were searched and not located (research items 48 to 50). The dossier does not estimate them. Customer concentration and segment margin remain unquantified, and the valuation does not rely on them.
Transcript coverage: no H1 FY2027 earnings-call transcript was retrieved. H1 FY2027 figures come from secondary summaries (Yahoo Finance, Quartr and a marketping concall summary).
Holding ledger: the Zerodha positions ledger has no AZAD line, and the last Zerodha transaction is dated 11 November 2026. No broker reconciliation was performed.

Chapter titles: ch-1 'Origin, Corporate Evolution & Operating Cycles' and ch-6 'Financial Forensics, Cash Conversion & Balance Sheet' differ from the canonical titles. ch-6 omits '10-Year' because only six years of audited data are available.

Market-wide research needs (FII/DII flows, put-call ratio, bulk deals, delivery data, results calendar, promoter pledge) were listed in the facts ledger and were not pursued for this company dossier. The market report owns them.

Intraday basis for the support zone: the 12 November ledger carries no pivot level, so the ₹2,175.84 to ₹2,242.10 zone and the ₹2,151.41 stop are anchored on the 13 November intraday TradingView daily S1 pivot of ₹2,208.97. The zone is a watch area, and the 12 November close is the price basis for every valuation figure.

Asymmetry convention: the support-zone asymmetry is measured from the top of the zone (₹2,242.10), the conservative entry reading, and gives 1.44 to 1 against the 1.5 to 1 minimum. Measured from the bottom of the zone (₹2,175.84) the same base-case reward gives about 8 to 1. The REJECTED verdict rests on the top-of-zone convention, and the weighted value of ₹2,369 is itself above the zone.
